card.title: Spare Them the Hassle
card.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down, love. You've been on the ward all night. I'll bring lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's there a bucket by my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just catching a drip. Take the sofa; I've made you a tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay here. I'll bring your duvet down; upstairs needs a little drying before I put your bed back.

mechanism: A minimizes a home-water problem while arranging food and a downstairs bed to spare an exhausted loved one.
confusable: Unlike concealment to avoid blame, A's protective motive must shape the practical work taken on alone.
comparison: D39-a relocates rest around water damage; D39-b assembles a multi-shop bike repair so B can keep reading.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
